HyperFlow

Evolutionary self-improving agent framework powered by LangChain and LangGraph. ⚠️ EXPERIMENTAL

Get StartedBasic Concepts

Self-Improving

Uses Quality-Diversity (QD) algorithms to maintain an archive of agent versions and automatically improve them.

Pluggable Architecture

Works with multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama) and is powered by standard LangChain and LangGraph abstractions.

Advanced Tooling

MetaAgent modifies TaskAgents locally or safely inside Docker containers using provided shell and editor tools.

Note: This is the Python port of Meta Research's original HyperAgents (2026).
